question: Which great six-syllabled mantra is invoked for protection here?
premises: The sequence oṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ namaḥ is given.
It is described as the great six-syllabled form.
inference: The great six-syllabled mantra oṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ namaḥ is invoked for protection.
plain_english: May the great six-syllabled mantra oṃ hrīṃ strīṃ hūṃ namaḥ protect.
